scenes: What happens to a hospital in a heatwave?
More patients arrive, | just as power, staff and supplies are stretched.
In 2024, Indian hospitals prepared heatstroke rooms, | ice baths and cooled beds before the peak.
And a clinic that loses power loses its cooling too. | Back-up power and a cool room keep care going.
Clinics that stay cool, so they can keep others cool.
